definitions.gloss: name tag, name plate, name badge
definitions.explanation: A tag or badge displaying a person's name, worn on clothing or placed on a desk or door. Used in schools, workplaces, conferences, and hospitals.

examples.english: To put on a name tag.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{参加者|さんかしゃ}は{名札|なふだ}を{胸|むね}に{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: The conference participants wore name tags on their chests.

examples.japanese: {小学生|しょうがくせい}は{名札|なふだ}に{名前|なまえ}と{学年|がくねん}を{書|か}く。
examples.english: Elementary school students write their name and grade on their name tag.

notes:
{名札|なふだ} is a tag or badge displaying a person's name. Compound of {名|な} (name) + {札|ふだ} (tag, card).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名札|なふだ}を{付|つ}ける/{着|つ}ける: to put on a name tag
- {名札|なふだ}を{外|はず}す: to take off a name tag
- {名札|なふだ}に{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}く: to write one's name on a tag

USAGE:
Common in Japanese schools (especially elementary), hospitals, conferences, and workplaces. Japanese {小学生|しょうがくせい} typically wear {名札|なふだ} on their clothes or bags with their name and class.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {名札|なふだ}: name tag (worn on person or placed on desk)
- {名刺|めいし}: business card (exchanged at meetings)
- {表札|ひょうさつ}: nameplate (on a house or building entrance)
- ネームプレート: name plate (loanword, often used in offices)
